task.title: Receipt OCR to structured JSON
task.business_story: Expense-management and bookkeeping tools turn photographed receipts into ledger entries; after OCR the text is jumbled, and a model has to pull out the line items and totals for every receipt a customer uploads. It runs once per document at high volume, so the per-call price decides the margin.

verdict.system_prompt:
The text below is the OCR output of a shop or restaurant receipt from Indonesia (amounts in rupiah). Extract the following as a JSON object and reply with the JSON only:
- "items": the purchased line items, each {"name": string as printed, "quantity": integer or null, "price": the line total as printed, integer}. Do not list sub-items or modifiers printed under an item.
- "subtotal", "discount", "service_charge", "tax", "total", "cash_paid", "change": integers, or null if the receipt does not print that amount.
Write every amount as a plain integer with no currency or separators ("Rp 25.000" -> 25000). Discounts are positive numbers.

Reply with one JSON object only, no code fences.
verdict.sentence: Use Nemotron 3.5 Lightning (thinking off) with the plain prompt: it scored 87.8% on 40 held-out examples, matching Ultra's 89.5% (within one row), at $0.0534 per 1k calls instead of $0.7388 (13.8x cheaper).
verdict.snippet:
import os
from openai import OpenAI

client = OpenAI(base_url="https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1", api_key=os.environ["NEBIUS_API_KEY"])

MODEL = 'nvidia/Nemotron-3_5-Lightning'
THINKING = False  # Nemotron reasoning; off is faster and cheaper
SYSTEM = 'The text below is the OCR output of a shop or restaurant receipt from Indonesia (amounts in rupiah). Extract the following as a JSON object and reply with the JSON only:\n- "items": the purchased line items, each {"name": string as printed, "quantity": integer or null, "price": the line total as printed, integer}. Do not list sub-items or modifiers printed under an item.\n- "subtotal", "discount", "service_charge", "tax", "total", "cash_paid", "change": integers, or null if the receipt does not print that amount.\nWrite every amount as a plain integer with no currency or separators ("Rp 25.000" -> 25000). Discounts are positive numbers.\n\nReply with one JSON object only, no code fences.'
FEW_SHOT = []


def run(text: str) -> str:
    messages = [{"role": "system", "content": SYSTEM}, *FEW_SHOT, {"role": "user", "content": text}]
    r = client.chat.completions.create(
        model=MODEL, messages=messages, temperature=0, max_tokens=385,
        extra_body={"chat_template_kwargs": {"enable_thinking": THINKING}},
    )
    if r.choices[0].finish_reason == "length":
        raise RuntimeError("ran out of tokens before answering")
    return r.choices[0].message.content.strip()
